rationale: No option leads clearly: the mobile clinic has the only precedent with numbers (40 percent fewer missed appointments), but its staffing cost and two-day cap limit it, telehealth excludes the least connected patients, and health workers scale too slowly. The margin between the options is small, so no recommendation is forced.
human_judge: panel-judge implementer reasoned expectation for the v1.0 gate (NOT an independent external human judge; see docs/EVAL-v1.0.md)
